title: Constipation & Bowel Irregularity (Vibhandha) — Dual-System Monograph
content:
Condition: Constipation (Vibhandha) & Sluggish Digestion (Malavastambha).
Allopathic Pharmacology: Ispaghula / Psyllium Husk (bulk-forming laxative 1-2 tablespoons in full glass of water). Lactulose syrup 15-30ml (osmotic laxative). Bisacodyl 5mg (stimulant laxative for short-term acute use).
Ayurvedic Formulations: Triphala Churna (Haritaki + Bibhitaki + Amalaki 3-5g with warm water at bedtime - mild colon cleanser and tonic). Gandharva Haritaki (3g with warm water). Castor oil with warm milk (Eranda Taila).
Home Remedies: Soaked Black Raisins / Munakka (6-8 soaked in water overnight, eaten morning), Warm water with lemon in morning, Prune juice or ripe Papaya daily, High dietary fiber (salads, whole grains) + 2.5-3L water daily.
Precautions: Drink plenty of water when taking bulk laxatives to prevent intestinal obstruction.
